postings.title: Account Executive
postings.description:
We’re hiring Account Executives to win and grow some of the most exciting accounts in financial services. You’ll own $100K+ deals, work closely with our founders and help shape how we sell a product that can change the way an entire industry operates.

You’ll have inbound interest, RFP opportunities, partner introductions and creative outreach to work with, alongside Commercial Associates and a team that gets behind its sellers. Your job is to turn that opportunity into lasting customer relationships and revenue.

About us

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

- $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

- Founders who have done this before. Mikkel and Cip built HelloFlow together and sold it to Trulioo in 2022. They’re now building spektr alongside co-founders Jan-Erik and Jeremy, taking on a much bigger part of the customer lifecycle.

- Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

- Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

What you’ll do

- Own your accounts and deals. Set the account strategy and lead the sales cycle, from discovery and qualification through proposals, pricing, negotiation and signature.

- Build relationships across the buying team. Understand what matters to Product, Operations and Compliance, develop champions and bring decision-makers together around a clear business case.

- Make the product real for customers. Learn the platform deeply, lead tailored demos and work with spektrQ, our implementation team, on more involved demos and proofs of concept.

- Turn interest into business. Progress inbound enquiries, partner introductions and RFP opportunities, while building new opportunities in your priority accounts.

- Work closely with Commercial Associates. Collaborate on research, outreach, meeting preparation and live deals. Give them context, share your judgement and help them take on more responsibility.

- Grow the accounts you win. Work with spektrQ to identify where customers could do more with spektr, then own the commercial side of expansion into new use cases, teams and markets.

- Keep deals moving. Follow up persistently, make next steps clear and maintain an honest forecast. Bring problems to the team early and help improve how we sell.

How we work

You own the deal. The whole company helps you win it.

Our AEs work closely with Commercial Associates throughout the sales process. spektrQ helps demonstrate what’s possible and how we’ll deliver it. Growth, marketing and partnerships create reasons for prospects to engage, and the founders get involved in strategic deals. You’ll have people to build with, challenge your thinking and help get things over the line.

We already have inbound interest and many opportunities to compete in RFPs. Alongside that, we actively go after the accounts we most want to work with. You’ll be expected to create opportunities too, with support and plenty of freedom in how you do it.

We pride ourselves on being one of the most creative outreach teams around. Nobody likes generic outreach. We send custom comics, make videos around a prospect’s business and bring people together at events. Sometimes a thoughtful email or a phone call is exactly what’s needed. Bring a good idea and you’ll find people who want to help make it happen.

Who you are

- An experienced B2B software seller. You’ve owned complex sales cycles, closed substantial deals and can explain how you made them happen.

- Comfortable building in an early-stage company. You’ve helped develop a sales approach, opened accounts or built a market. Founding AE experience is especially relevant.

- Strong at discovery and commercial judgement. You can uncover the real problem, understand a buying process, build a business case and negotiate with confidence.

- Personable and credible. You build trust with senior people, ask good questions and know how to win support across a buying team.

- Curious about the product. You want to use it, understand it and show customers what they could build with it.

- Resourceful and persistent. You take initiative, find ways around obstacles and keep following up.

- Generous with what you know. You enjoy developing others, work well across teams and take feedback as readily as you give it.

Experience selling into financial services or regulated businesses is useful. What matters most is your ability to learn a complex product, understand the customer and close.

Why join

- $100K+ deals, with relatively quick sales cycles for our industry. Win substantial business with ambitious companies, with room to grow those accounts as they adopt more of the platform.

- A product you can believe in. Work with technology already used by demanding financial businesses, in an industry ready for a better way of doing things.

- Several ways into a deal. Build on inbound interest, RFPs, partnerships and events, alongside targeted outreach.

- A team behind you. Work with Commercial Associates, product experts and founders who get involved in helping you win.

- A chance to shape the company. Help build our commercial approach, develop people and feed what you learn from customers directly into the business.

The process

- Initial conversation with our Head of Growth or Chief of Staff

- Case study

- Final conversation with our CEO

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

postings.title: AI Engineer
postings.description:
WHY SPEKTR

At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

- $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

- Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

- Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for an AI Engineer who is, first and foremost, a product builder. In this role, you won't just be running experiments in a notebook; you will own the end-to-end AI strategy and its direct impact on our customers.

In this role, you will own everything related to AI, LLMs, and intelligent automation.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing company. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, loves solving complex compliance puzzles, and is eager to shape the next generation of compliance technology.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- AI Strategy & Ownership: Own the end-to-end AI roadmap—from selecting the right models (SOTA commercial vs. fine-tuned open source) to deciding how they are integrated into the product core.

- Agentic Feature Design: Design and deploy LLM-powered features including autonomous agents, advanced RAG pipelines, and intelligent document understanding.

- Product-Led AI: Collaborate directly with founders to translate complex compliance "puzzles" into scalable AI solutions. You own the "Why" behind every model choice.

- Continuous Innovation: Stay at the bleeding edge of AI/ML research, proactively identifying new papers or releases that can give spektr a competitive advantage.

- Engineering for Reliability: Turn non-deterministic AI outputs into deterministic product value. You ensure our agents are accurate, explainable, and hallucination-free.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- The Product Mindset: You are a product person at heart. You care about whether the AI actually solves the user's problem, not just if the loss curve is going down.

- High-Agency Builder: You prefer building systems over following manuals. You identify bottlenecks in our AI workflows and fix them before they become tickets.

- AI/ML Expertise: 2+ years of experience in ML, AI, or Data/Backend roles with a deep understanding of modern LLM stacks.

- Technical Mastery: Strong skills in TypeScript (our core) and/or Python, with hands-on experience in frameworks like LangChain or equivalent orchestration layers.

- RAG & Vector Mastery: You’ve built production-grade RAG pipelines and understand the nuances of embedding, retrieval strategy, and re-ranking.

- Evaluation Obsession: You understand that "it works on my machine" doesn't apply to LLMs. You have experience setting up evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

- Cloud & Scale: Experience deploying AI services in AWS or containerized environments, ensuring they are scalable and cost-effective.

- Communication: You can explain the trade-offs of a specific model architecture to a founder and a technical bottleneck to a peer with equal clarity.

OUR TECH INTERESTS

- Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Open Source (LLaMA, Mistral).

- Stack: TypeScript, Python, LangChain, etc

- Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD for LLMs.

OUR PROCESS

- Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (60 minutes)

HOW TO APPLY

We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

postings.title: Commercial Associate
postings.description:
We’re hiring Commercial Associates to help us win some of the most exciting accounts in financial services. You’ll work closely with our commercial and founding teams on everything from opening doors to shaping deal strategy and bringing the product to life. If you want to learn fast, take responsibility and help build a company, read on.

This isn’t an SDR or BDR role. You’ll be involved beyond the first meeting, helping shape deals and build customer relationships. As your product knowledge and commercial judgement develop, you’ll increasingly take on your own accounts, lead customer conversations and own how those opportunities move forward, with the team’s support.

About us

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

- $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

- Founders who have done this before. Mikkel and Cip built HelloFlow together and sold it to Trulioo in 2022. They’re now building spektr alongside co-founders Jan-Erik and Jeremy, taking on a much bigger part of the customer lifecycle.

- Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

- Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

What you’ll do

- Research priority accounts, understand their business and work out who we should speak to, what matters to them and why spektr is relevant.

- Help shape account plans and deal strategies, turning research into a compelling story for senior decision-makers.

- Find creative ways to start conversations, from personal videos and custom comics to calls, introductions and events. Use what works and keep following up.

- Create tailored demos, presentations, videos and other materials that show prospects what spektr could do for them.

- Work on live opportunities, from preparing customer meetings to developing proposals and answering questions about the platform, increasingly taking ownership of your own accounts as you develop.

- Work across the company to bring good ideas to life and help shape how we go to market as we grow.

How we work

You won’t be stuck in a call booth making cold calls all day. We reach out with whatever works, and we pride ourselves on being one of the most creative outreach teams around.

Nobody likes generic outreach. We send custom comics, make videos around a prospect’s business and bring people together at events. Sometimes a thoughtful email or a phone call is exactly what’s needed. You’ll have the freedom to work out what will resonate, try it and keep finding ways to start a conversation.

The whole company gets behind you. Growth, marketing, product, engineering and the founders all get involved. Bring a good idea and you’ll find people who want to help make it happen.

Who you are

- Ambitious and early in your commercial career, with an appetite to learn quickly and take on more responsibility.

- Personable, curious and good at winning people over. You listen well, build rapport and enjoy getting to know people.

- Resourceful and persistent. You try different approaches, take initiative and follow through.

- A clear communicator, whether you’re writing an email, building a presentation or explaining an idea in a room.

- Comfortable getting into the details of a product and figuring out how it solves a real business problem.

- Open to feedback, willing to get stuck in and excited by a role that will develop as you do.

You might come from consulting, banking, sales or a startup, or have built something of your own. We’re interested in what you’ve taken responsibility for, how you think and how quickly you learn. Prior compliance experience isn’t a requirement.

Why join

- Learn how a company grows. Work closely with experienced founders and commercial colleagues on substantial accounts and real deals.

- Sell a product you can believe in. Get hands-on with a platform already used by demanding financial businesses, solving problems that matter to them.

- Have room to be creative. Help shape our approach, try ideas and get support from people across the company.

- Build towards owning your own accounts. Take increasing responsibility for account strategy, customer relationships and moving deals forward. You’ll have support as you grow towards an AE role, with ownership earned through what you demonstrate.

- Be recognised for your contribution. Commercial Associates have no individual quota. We look at the quality of your work, what you learn and how you help opportunities progress.

The process

- Initial conversation with our Head of Growth or Chief of Staff

- Case study

- Final conversation with our CEO

postings.title: DevOps Engineer
postings.description:
WHY SPEKTR

At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

- $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

- Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

- Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team in Iasi and help us scale infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability across our growing backend ecosystem.

You will work alongside our senior platform engineers on our Kubernetes-native stack, taking ownership of real infrastructure from early on. This is a role where you'll learn by building: our environment is modern and opinionated, and you'll be running production infrastructure for financial institutions, not sandbox projects.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Infrastructure as Code: Build and maintain our AWS infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt, starting with well-scoped modules and growing into larger architectural work.

- Kubernetes Operations: Support our EKS clusters and a rapidly growing microservices environment (NestJS backend), handling deployments, troubleshooting, and day-to-day cluster health.

- CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

- GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

- Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

- Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

- High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

- Foundations: 3–5 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

- Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

- Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

- CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

- Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

- Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

OUR TECH INTERESTS

- Cloud & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm

- IaC: Terraform, Terragrunt

- CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub/Gitlab, ArgoCD

- Observability: DataDog

OUR PROCESS

- Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (60 minutes)

HOW TO APPLY

We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

postings.title: Finance Operations
postings.description:
Finance Associate (Finance Operations)
Copenhagen · Full-time

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can work together, with the controls they need to grow.

There’s a lot to build in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help build the company behind it.

A few things about us

- $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

- Founders who have done this before. Mikkel and Cip built HelloFlow together and sold it to Trulioo in 2022. They’re now building spektr alongside co-founders Jan-Erik and Jeremy, taking on a much bigger part of the customer lifecycle.

- Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander Leasing. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

- Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

The role

You’ll take over spektr’s finance operations and own them across our three entities in Denmark, the UK and Romania. You’ll work directly with our Chief of Staff and the leadership team, and build the finance function as the company scales.

What you will do

- Run day-to-day finance operations: invoicing, expenses, payables, bank reconciliations and month-end close

- Design, implement and optimise the financial systems (ERP setup, expense controls, tooling), processes and internal controls that allows spektr to keep scaling further

- Own FP&A: budget, forecasts, cash runway and the key metrics leadership runs the business on

- Deliver accurate, investor-ready reporting, including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

- Own the relationship with our external accountants on bookkeeping, VAT, payroll and year-end

- Build and improve our finance stack, using automation and AI wherever it saves time

- Give compliance, audit and fundraising the numbers they need, when they need them

- Work closely with the leadership team to turn numbers into clear commercial recommendations

What makes you a great fit

- 1 to 3 years in finance operations, FP&A or a similar finance role, ideally at a software or scaling start-up

- A solid understanding of SaaS metrics: ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, burn multiple

- A solid grasp of accounting: you can build and read a P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and you know how a month-end close works

- Hands-on with accounting and spend tools and strong in Excel or Google Sheets

- You have built and run finance processes before or have seen what good looks like

- You are highly analytical and stay structured even when things move fast

- You are self-driven, execute fast with limited information and drive your own projects

postings.title: Product Owner
postings.description:
WHY SPEKTR

At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

$26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re hiring a Product Owner to build products that compliance teams at banks and payment companies rely on every day, in more than 15 countries. You’ll work across the core of the spektr platform, from onboarding and monitoring to investigations, where our AI agents are taking on work that used to take analysts hours.

You will shape what compliance looks like when AI agents do most of the work. You’ll prototype, put ideas in front of compliance teams early, and work with engineering and design to ship what holds up in a regulated environment. You’ll do it at a Series A startup that moves fast, with the autonomy to take an idea from a blank page to a product running at banks and payment companies.

This is a chance to help define how compliance gets done, not to digitise the way it’s always been done.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Prototype fast and test with real users. Build working prototypes, often with AI tools, and put them in front of compliance and operations teams at banks and payment companies in days rather than months. Keep what works and drop what doesn’t.

- Explore several ways to solve a problem before committing to one, and come back with a clear view on which gives users the best experience, and why.

- Shape the product experience with our designers. Make complex compliance workflows simple to use, so analysts spend their time on decisions, not on the tool.

- Push how far AI can go in compliance. Our customers are regulated institutions, so every automated decision has to be explainable and defensible. You’ll work out what our AI agents can take on, what a human still needs to review, and what it takes for a compliance team to trust the result, then move that line further with each release.

- Turn customer requests into platform capabilities. When a customer asks for something specific, find the version that solves their problem and fits into the existing platform, so it stays configurable and works for the next customer too.

- Work hand in hand with engineering in Copenhagen and Iași. Align on what we’re building and why, agree how it fits the platform’s direction, and make the calls that keep work moving.

- Learn from the field. Work with our implementation team, who sit on site with customers and see every rough edge first, and use what they and our production data show you to decide what to improve.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- You’ve owned product on a B2B platform and can show us what you built, how you tested it with users and what changed as a result. Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry is a plus.

- You build with AI. AI tools are part of how you prototype, research and explore ideas every day, and you have a view on how AI is changing the way products get made.

- Hands-on and fast. You’d rather show a working prototype than describe one, and you’re comfortable putting early work in front of users to learn quickly.

- Strong product and UX instincts. You can take a complex workflow and make it feel simple, and explain why one design works better than another.

- A platform thinker. When a customer asks for something, you look for the solution that fits the existing platform and scales beyond that one customer.

- Technical enough to go deep with engineers. You understand how systems, data and APIs fit together, and engineers want you in the room when decisions get made.

- Opinionated and open. You have a clear view on how things should work, argue for it, and change your mind when users or evidence show you otherwise.

- Close to customers by instinct. You’d rather sit in on a call with a bank’s onboarding team than read a summary of it.

Your route into product might have been through engineering, design, data, solutions architecture or operations. We’re interested in what you’ve built, how you think, and how quickly you learn. Prior compliance experience is a plus but isn’t a requirement.

OUR PROCESS

- Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (60 minutes)

HOW TO APPLY

We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

postings.title: QA Engineer (Automation)
postings.description:
WHY SPEKTR

At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

Compliance, built like product.

Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

- $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

- Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

- Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

- Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

- API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

- CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

- Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

- Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

- Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

- API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

- Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

- Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

- Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

- Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

OUR TECH INTERESTS

- Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

- Testing: Playwright

- AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

- Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

OUR PROCESS

- Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (30 minutes)

- Technical Interview (60 minutes)

HOW TO APPLY

We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.
